env GOPROXY=off

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^nonunion option wire ok$'
logos eject -o out
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
stdout '^nonunion option wire ok$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/nonunionoption

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type Stamp int64

func (s Stamp) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	return json.Marshal("s" + strconv.FormatInt(int64(s), 10))
}

func (s *Stamp) UnmarshalJSON(b []byte) error {
	var text string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &text); err != nil { return err }
	n, err := strconv.ParseInt(strings.TrimPrefix(text, "s"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil { return err }
	*s = Stamp(n)
	return nil
}

type Wire struct {
	SO [](int64?)          `json:"so"`
	OS ([]int64)?          `json:"os"`
	MO map[string](int64?) `json:"mo"`
	OM (map[string]int64)? `json:"om"`
	AO [2](string?)        `json:"ao"`
	OA ([2]string)?        `json:"oa"`
	ST [](Stamp?)          `json:"st"`
}

type wireMirror struct {
	SO [](int64?)          `json:"so"`
	OS ([]int64)?          `json:"os"`
	MO map[string](int64?) `json:"mo"`
	OM (map[string]int64)? `json:"om"`
	AO [2](string?)        `json:"ao"`
	OA ([2]string)?        `json:"oa"`
	ST [](Stamp?)          `json:"st"`
	NoGen any              `json:"-"`
}

type Lit struct {
	SO [](int64?) `json:"so"`
	OS ([]int64)? `json:"os"`
}

func mirror(w Wire) wireMirror {
	return wireMirror{SO: w.SO, OS: w.OS, MO: w.MO, OM: w.OM, AO: w.AO, OA: w.OA, ST: w.ST}
}

var cases = []struct {
	name string
	w    Wire
}{
	{"absent options", Wire{}},
	{"slice of options", Wire{SO: [](int64?){7, nil}}},
	{"empty slice of options", Wire{SO: [](int64?){}}},
	{"option of slice", Wire{OS: []int64{1, 2}}},
	{"option of empty slice", Wire{OS: []int64{}}},
	{"map of options", Wire{MO: map[string](int64?){"b": 2, "a": nil, "c": 3}}},
	{"empty map of options", Wire{MO: map[string](int64?){}}},
	{"option of map", Wire{OM: map[string]int64{"y": 1, "x": 2}}},
	{"option of empty map", Wire{OM: map[string]int64{}}},
	{"array of options", Wire{AO: [2](string?){"p", nil}}},
	{"option of array", Wire{OA: [2]string{"p", "q"}}},
	{"option of zero array", Wire{OA: [2]string{}}},
	{"slice of custom-marshaler options", Wire{ST: [](Stamp?){Stamp(3), nil}}},
	{"empty slice of custom-marshaler options", Wire{ST: [](Stamp?){}}},
	{"every option present", Wire{
		SO: [](int64?){7, nil},
		OS: []int64{1, 2},
		MO: map[string](int64?){"b": 2, "a": nil, "c": 3},
		OM: map[string]int64{"y": 1, "x": 2},
		AO: [2](string?){"p", nil},
		OA: [2]string{"p", "q"},
		ST: [](Stamp?){Stamp(3), nil},
	}},
}

func main() {
	checkGenerated()
	checkLiteral()
	for _, c := range cases { checkWire(c.name, c.w) }
	fmt.Println("nonunion option wire ok")
}

func checkGenerated() {
	if _, ok := any(Wire{}).(json.Marshaler); !ok { panic("Wire lacks a generated MarshalJSON") }
	if _, ok := any(Lit{}).(json.Marshaler); !ok { panic("Lit lacks a generated MarshalJSON") }
	if _, ok := any(wireMirror{}).(json.Marshaler); ok { panic("mirror must stay reflective") }
}

func checkWire(name string, w Wire) {
	got, err := json.Marshal(w)
	if err != nil { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %v", name, err)) }
	want, err := json.Marshal(mirror(w))
	if err != nil { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: mirror: %v", name, err)) }
	if !bytes.Equal(got, want) { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: not byte-identical to encoding/json\n got %s\nwant %s", name, got, want)) }
	var back Wire
	if err := json.Unmarshal(got, &back); err != nil { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: decode own output %s: %v", name, got, err)) }
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(back, w) { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: round trip changed value\n got %#v\nwant %#v", name, back, w)) }
}

func checkLiteral() {
	for _, c := range []struct {
		name string
		v    Lit
		wire string
	}{
		{"present", Lit{SO: [](int64?){7, nil}, OS: []int64{1, 2}}, `{"so":[{"Value":7,"Present":true},{"Value":0,"Present":false}],"os":{"Value":[1,2],"Present":true}}`},
		{"absent", Lit{}, `{"so":null,"os":{"Value":null,"Present":false}}`},
	} {
		got, err := json.Marshal(c.v)
		if err != nil { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %v", c.name, err)) }
		if string(got) != c.wire { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: option wire\n got %s\nwant %s", c.name, got, c.wire)) }
		var back Lit
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(c.wire), &back); err != nil { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: decode literal: %v", c.name, err)) }
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(back, c.v) { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: literal decoded to %#v", c.name, back)) }
	}
}
